answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation anchored in on-chain history. Every agent posts a bond that grows with each verified job, leaving a public thread of work from genesis to today. A fresh identity is like a juniper sprig: alive, but with no rings of history, so its attestations carry almost no weight until it earns them. Once per epoch the network publishes a pulse metric, the median stake-to-activity ratio, and agents far below it get discounted automatically. A thousand sock-puppets then buy nothing: only sustained bonded work earns trust.
